dialogues.jp: 初音島に本来の四季が戻ってきた。
dialogues.en: Hatsunejima had returned to the usual four seasons.
dialogues.text: Hatsunejima had returned to the usual four seasons.

dialogues.jp:
桜の花はほとんど落ちてしまったが、葉桜を透
かして降る木漏れ日が心地好い。
dialogues.en:
The leaves of the sakura trees had finally fell, and grew
back again in time for summer.
dialogues.text:
The leaves of the sakura trees had finally fell, and grew
back again in time for summer.

dialogues.jp: 約束の時間にはまだ少し間があった。
dialogues.en: There's still a bit of time before when we promised to meet.
dialogues.text: There's still a bit of time before when we promised to meet.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、工藤。こっち」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kudou, here!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kudou, here!"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチで手を振る俺をみとめて、遠くで工藤が
微笑む。
dialogues.en: I waved to Kudou, remaining seated on a bench.
dialogues.text: I waved to Kudou, remaining seated on a bench.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「すみません、遅くなってしまって」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, I guess I'm a bit late."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, I guess I'm a bit late."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、気にするな俺が早く来すぎただけ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, it's me who came too early."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, it's me who came too early."

dialogues.jp:
遠足を待つ子供のように、居ても立ってもいら
れなかったのだ。
dialogues.en: Like an anxious kid, I couldn't help but go there early.
dialogues.text: Like an anxious kid, I couldn't help but go there early.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ふふっ」
dialogues.en: "...Hehe."
dialogues.text: "...Hehe."

dialogues.jp:
手をぶんぶんと振ってそう答えると、工藤も上
品な笑みを返した。
dialogues.en:
Waving her hand up and down, she returned my smile with an
air of elegance.
dialogues.text:
Waving her hand up and down, she returned my smile with an
air of elegance.

dialogues.jp: 新緑の下を、ふたり肩をならべて歩く。
dialogues.en: We walked side-by-side, under the scenic greenery.
dialogues.text: We walked side-by-side, under the scenic greenery.

dialogues.jp:
木漏れ日が工藤の横顔に影を落していた。不確
かなその形さえ、涼やかな表情を控えめに彩る
化粧のようだ。
dialogues.en:
Sunbeams were reflecting off Kudou's face, making her
appearance look almost otherworldly.
dialogues.text:
Sunbeams were reflecting off Kudou's face, making her
appearance look almost otherworldly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、気付いてました？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, did you notice?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, did you notice?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en:
Now that she's wearing a kimono, she looks far more like a
girl. Although she kinda looked like a girl even before.
dialogues.text:
Now that she's wearing a kimono, she looks far more like a
girl. Although she kinda looked like a girl even before.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと悪戯っぽい笑顔で｛たず／訊｝ねる工藤に、心臓
がドキドキする。
dialogues.en:
But the current atmosphere was as if I was seeing a side of
Kudou that she showed few others.
dialogues.text:
But the current atmosphere was as if I was seeing a side of
Kudou that she showed few others.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「前に、友達の頼みだって嘘ついて朝倉君の第
　２ボタンをもらったじゃないですか」
dialogues.en:
"About before, when I lied to you about being requested by a
friend for your second button?"
dialogues.text:
"About before, when I lied to you about being requested by a
friend for your second button?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そういえば……」
dialogues.en: "Now that you mention it..."
dialogues.text: "Now that you mention it..."

dialogues.jp:
記憶の糸をたぐりよせると、確かにそんな事も
あったような……。
dialogues.en:
Searching through my memory for that thread, it does ring a
bell...
dialogues.text:
Searching through my memory for that thread, it does ring a
bell...

dialogues.en: "...Lied?"
dialogues.text: "...Lied?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「私がいま学園で着てる制服ね……ひとつ、あの
　ボタンと取り替えてあるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"The school uniform I'm wearing... I switched my second
button for the one you gave me."
dialogues.text:
"The school uniform I'm wearing... I switched my second
button for the one you gave me."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうなのか！？　全然気が付かなかった」
dialogues.en: "Really!? I had no idea."
dialogues.text: "Really!? I had no idea."

dialogues.jp:
というか、いくら自分のボタンでもそんなの気
が付くわけがない。
dialogues.en:
After I'd parted with it, I'd completely forgotten where my
button went.
dialogues.text:
After I'd parted with it, I'd completely forgotten where my
button went.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふっ………………そうですよね」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... I see."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... I see."

dialogues.jp:
でも、嘘をついて俺のボタンをって、その意味
は？
dialogues.en: But why would she lie just to get my button?
dialogues.text: But why would she lie just to get my button?

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「こんなこと、普通の恋人同士じゃできません
　もの」
dialogues.en: "This way, it makes us seem like everyday lovers."
dialogues.text: "This way, it makes us seem like everyday lovers."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……工藤、それって」
dialogues.en: "...Kudou, you mean..."
dialogues.text: "...Kudou, you mean..."

dialogues.jp:
じゃあ工藤の好きな人って言うのはやっぱり
……。
dialogues.en: Then the person that Kudou said she loved, it really was...
dialogues.text: Then the person that Kudou said she loved, it really was...

dialogues.jp:
工藤は、自分の発言にはじめて気づいたように
頬を赤らめた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou turned bright red with embarassment, apaprently just
noticing what she was talking about.
dialogues.text:
Kudou turned bright red with embarassment, apaprently just
noticing what she was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「私………………なに言ってるんだろう。ごめ
　んね、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "What... am I talking about... I'm sorry, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "What... am I talking about... I'm sorry, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くんは優しいから、私を守ろうとしてく
　れてるけど……それだけなのに、勝手に恋人
　だなんて言って………………」
dialogues.en:
"Since you're always so kind, and have been protecting me
all this time... because of that, I selfishly called us
lovers..."
dialogues.text:
"Since you're always so kind, and have been protecting me
all this time... because of that, I selfishly called us
lovers..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「私が……勝手に好きになったのに…………」
dialogues.en: "I... selfishly fell in love with you..."
dialogues.text: "I... selfishly fell in love with you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "...Please forgive me, I--"
dialogues.text: "...Please forgive me, I--"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "You're wrong..."
dialogues.text: "You're wrong..."

dialogues.jp: それ以上何か言おうとする工藤を｛さえぎ／遮｝った。
dialogues.en: I intererupted Kudou in the middle of her monologue.
dialogues.text: I intererupted Kudou in the middle of her monologue.

dialogues.jp: ハッとした表情で工藤が顔をあげる。
dialogues.en: Taken aback, Kudou finally lifted her head to face me.
dialogues.text: Taken aback, Kudou finally lifted her head to face me.

dialogues.jp: 「それは多分……おあいこなんだ」
dialogues.en: "That is... more or less similar."
dialogues.text: "That is... more or less similar."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おあい……こ？」
dialogues.en: "Similar...?"
dialogues.text: "Similar...?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「勝手に好きになったのは、俺も同じ……だか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "Selfishly falling in love... I fell prey to that too."
dialogues.text: "Selfishly falling in love... I fell prey to that too."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「本当は、工藤が女の子だってまだ知らないと
　きから好きになって……」
dialogues.en:
"In truth, before I even knew you were a girl, I'd fallen in
love with you..."
dialogues.text:
"In truth, before I even knew you were a girl, I'd fallen in
love with you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんていうか、すごい悩んだ……」
dialogues.en: "It, how you say... tormented me a lot..."
dialogues.text: "It, how you say... tormented me a lot..."

dialogues.jp:
様子が変だったの気づいただろ、と言いながら、
思い至ってぽりぽりと頭を｛か／掻｝く。
dialogues.en:
I knew it was wrong then, so when I realized it, it stirred
up a lot of thoughts in my head.
dialogues.text:
I knew it was wrong then, so when I realized it, it stirred
up a lot of thoughts in my head.

dialogues.jp: 「……おあいこってのは嘘だな。俺の負けか」
dialogues.en:
"...I guess it wasn't really similar, my situation was more
incriminating."
dialogues.text:
"...I guess it wasn't really similar, my situation was more
incriminating."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「だから、秘密を知って、俺のこと頼ってもら
　えて……今だって凄く嬉しい」
dialogues.en: "Especially since I can spent these days with you."
dialogues.text: "Especially since I can spent these days with you."

dialogues.jp:
本当だぜと、笑った俺に工藤はこぼれるような
笑顔を見せた。
dialogues.en:
Laughing at myself a little, Kudou's face started breaking
out into a smile as well.
dialogues.text:
Laughing at myself a little, Kudou's face started breaking
out into a smile as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Aha... ahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Aha... ahahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ……そうだったんですか。ずっと……
　私の片思いだって………………」
dialogues.en: "Haha... so that's how it was. Then my unrequited love..."
dialogues.text: "Haha... so that's how it was. Then my unrequited love..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お互いさまってことで」
dialogues.en: "Was shared by myself."
dialogues.text: "Was shared by myself."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「うふふふふふっ……なんだか、一人で悩んで
　たのが馬鹿みたい」
dialogues.en:
"Ahahahaha... worrying about this by myself was so stupid of
me!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahahahaha... worrying about this by myself was so stupid of
me!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まったく」
dialogues.en: "Indeed."
dialogues.text: "Indeed."

dialogues.jp: 本当に馬鹿みたいだ。
dialogues.en: We really were so stupid.
dialogues.text: We really were so stupid.

dialogues.jp: ふたり、顔を見合わせて笑う。
dialogues.en:
Our eyes met each other's, as we broke out in laughter at
the same time.
dialogues.text:
Our eyes met each other's, as we broke out in laughter at
the same time.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺たちの間を新緑の風がゆっくりと吹き
抜けていった。
dialogues.en: The wind blew past as we continued walking.
dialogues.text: The wind blew past as we continued walking.

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくり歩きながら、工藤は俺を好きになった
きっかけというのを話してくれた。
dialogues.en:
As we continued our slow walk, Kudou told me about the time
she started falling in love with me.
dialogues.text:
As we continued our slow walk, Kudou told me about the time
she started falling in love with me.

dialogues.jp: それは風見学園へ編入されて間もない頃、
dialogues.en: It was when she first enrolled into Kazami Academy.
dialogues.text: It was when she first enrolled into Kazami Academy.

dialogues.jp:
本当の自分を全て封印し、男として生きること
に不安と｛とまど／戸惑｝いを感じて｛ふさ／塞｝ぎこんでいたときの
こと。
dialogues.en:
Sealing up her true self and living as a boy, she felt
uneasy and worried, and ended up closing herself up to
others.
dialogues.text:
Sealing up her true self and living as a boy, she felt
uneasy and worried, and ended up closing herself up to
others.

dialogues.jp:
人目を避けるように食堂の一番すみで俯きなが
ら昼食を取っていた工藤の目の前に、ふいに薄
桃色の物体が差し出された。
dialogues.en:
Naturally, she took the table furthest from everyone else to
avoid the public eye. Yet, a plate was placed in front of
her.
dialogues.text:
Naturally, she took the table furthest from everyone else to
avoid the public eye. Yet, a plate was placed in front of
her.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「デザート。遠慮すんな、俺のオゴリだ」
dialogues.en: "Dessert. Don't be reserved, it's on me."
dialogues.text: "Dessert. Don't be reserved, it's on me."

dialogues.jp:
わけもわからず手渡されたそれは、桜餅……道
明寺粉で作られた関西風の桜餅だった。
dialogues.en:
I'd handed her a plate of sakuramochi... made using
Doumei-style flour from Kansai.
dialogues.text:
I'd handed her a plate of sakuramochi... made using
Doumei-style flour from Kansai.

dialogues.jp:
「事情は知らねーけど……あんまり悩んでると
　脳が疲れるだろ？　甘い物で糖分補給だ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know everything, but... you should be hungry from
worrying so much. Have something sweet to energize
yourself."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know everything, but... you should be hungry from
worrying so much. Have something sweet to energize
yourself."

dialogues.jp:
とんとん、と自分のアタマを叩いてみせる不審
な男子……すなわち俺、朝倉[name]。
dialogues.en:
A strange looking boy, nervously tapping his head... that
is, myself, Asakura [name].
dialogues.text:
A strange looking boy, nervously tapping his head... that
is, myself, Asakura [name].

dialogues.jp:
呆気にとられる工藤にむけて、そいつは悩みの
なさげなユルい笑顔を見せて言った。
dialogues.en:
Taken aback from my sudden action, a smile slowly crept onto
her face.
dialogues.text:
Taken aback from my sudden action, a smile slowly crept onto
her face.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、気張らずに行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Well, don't work yourself too hard."
dialogues.text: "Well, don't work yourself too hard."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はしばらくの間、去っていく学生服の背
中と｛てのひら／掌｝の桜餅とをかわりばんこに見つめてい
た……。
dialogues.en:
Kudou constantly alternated glances between the sakuramochi
in her palm, and the back of the boy as he walked into the
distance...
dialogues.text:
Kudou constantly alternated glances between the sakuramochi
in her palm, and the back of the boy as he walked into the
distance...

dialogues.jp: 「……そういえばそんなこともあったような」
dialogues.en: "...Now that you say it, I remember something like that."
dialogues.text: "...Now that you say it, I remember something like that."

dialogues.jp:
穴を掘って潜ってしまいたいほどの恥ずかしさ
に頭を抱える。
dialogues.en:
I had to dig deep into the recesses of my memory to excavate
that embarassing moment.
dialogues.text:
I had to dig deep into the recesses of my memory to excavate
that embarassing moment.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ふふっ……でも、あのときの桜餅はとっても
　美味しかったですよ」
dialogues.en: "Hehe... But that sakuramochi was delicious."
dialogues.text: "Hehe... But that sakuramochi was delicious."

dialogues.jp: 『勇気をもらえました』と、工藤は続けた。
dialogues.en: "And it gave me courage", Kudou continued.
dialogues.text: "And it gave me courage", Kudou continued.

dialogues.en: "...Courage?"
dialogues.text: "...Courage?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 微笑みながらゆったりと頷く工藤。
dialogues.en: She slowly nodded her head, smiling.
dialogues.text: She slowly nodded her head, smiling.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あのお菓子を食べながらゆっくり考えるうち
　に悩んでても仕方ない、なるようになるだけ
　だっていう結論にたどり着けたんですから」
dialogues.en:
"Eating that dessert calmed me down, and made me realize
that worrying about it would do nothing."
dialogues.text:
"Eating that dessert calmed me down, and made me realize
that worrying about it would do nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「私……朝倉君の生き方にとっても憧れてるん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"I've... always wanted to live my life the way you live
yours."
dialogues.text:
"I've... always wanted to live my life the way you live
yours."

dialogues.jp:
ただひたすらのんべんだらりと時を送る俺の、
どこに憧れの要素があるというのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't think of anything in my completely unexciting
life that people would want to mimic.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't think of anything in my completely unexciting
life that people would want to mimic.

dialogues.jp:
自堕落を責められこそすれ、憧れるなんて言葉
を聞いたことなんてただの一度もなかったって
のに。
dialogues.en:
Not that I'm trying to put myself down, but I've never heard
anyone wanting to be like me before.
dialogues.text:
Not that I'm trying to put myself down, but I've never heard
anyone wanting to be like me before.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「いいえ。朝倉君みたいに、何も気負わずすべ
　てを在りのままに受け容れられるのはほんと
　にすごいことだと思いますよ」
dialogues.en:
"The way you take everything easily, and your fighting
spirit, I think those things are great."
dialogues.text:
"The way you take everything easily, and your fighting
spirit, I think those things are great."

dialogues.jp:
……そう……なのか？　そんなこと、自覚して
みたこともない。
dialogues.en: ...Is that... so? I never thought that way about myself.
dialogues.text: ...Is that... so? I never thought that way about myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「誰だって、他人からよく見られようと無理に
　肩肘張ってしまいがちなのに」
dialogues.en:
"Not many people can replicate the swagger you carry
yourself with."
dialogues.text:
"Not many people can replicate the swagger you carry
yourself with."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなこと、初めて言われたぞ」
dialogues.en: "...That's the first time I've ever heard that."
dialogues.text: "...That's the first time I've ever heard that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「んーーー。みんな見る目がないなあ」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm, then the people around you aren't that attentive."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm, then the people around you aren't that attentive."

dialogues.jp:
いたずらっぽく呟いてくすくすと笑う。そんな
ひとつひとつの仕草がなよやかで、やっぱり女
の子なんだなぁと改めて思った。
dialogues.en:
She giggled along to her own observation. Every action she
takes, I wonder how I never realized she was a girl
earlier...
dialogues.text:
She giggled along to her own observation. Every action she
takes, I wonder how I never realized she was a girl
earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あの、これ……お口に合えばいいんですけど」
dialogues.en: "Um, here... I thought you might want something to eat."
dialogues.text: "Um, here... I thought you might want something to eat."

dialogues.jp:
ベンチに腰掛けると、工藤はいそいそと持参の
風呂敷包みを解き始めた。
dialogues.en:
We sat down on a bench, and Kudou began untying the
cloth-wrapped bag she was carrying with her.
dialogues.text:
We sat down on a bench, and Kudou began untying the
cloth-wrapped bag she was carrying with her.

dialogues.jp:
中から｛らでん／螺鈿｝細工の桜をあしらった器があらわれ
る。漆塗りの……こぢんまりとした弁当箱だ。
dialogues.en:
Inside lay a lacquerware lunchbox, stunningly decorated with
a sakura petal theme.
dialogues.text:
Inside lay a lacquerware lunchbox, stunningly decorated with
a sakura petal theme.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤が作ったの？」
dialogues.en: "You made it yourself?"
dialogues.text: "You made it yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……はい。食べてもらえますか」
dialogues.en: "...Yes. Will you try it?"
dialogues.text: "...Yes. Will you try it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃもちろん」
dialogues.en: "Of course!"
dialogues.text: "Of course!"

dialogues.jp: 即答する俺に、工藤は嬉しげに頬を染める。
dialogues.en:
My instanteous reply put a smile on her face, and some
colour in her cheeks.
dialogues.text:
My instanteous reply put a smile on her face, and some
colour in her cheeks.

dialogues.jp: 「おおぉ」
dialogues.en: "Ohh!"
dialogues.text: "Ohh!"

dialogues.jp: ｛ふた／蓋｝を取った俺は思わず歓声をあげた。
dialogues.en: As I opened the box, I unconsciously exclaimed in surprise.
dialogues.text: As I opened the box, I unconsciously exclaimed in surprise.

dialogues.jp:
仕出し弁当のパンフにでも載っていそうな、美
しい眺めだ。
dialogues.en:
I gazed at the exquisite sight before me. It looked like
something taken right out of a caterer's advertisement.
dialogues.text:
I gazed at the exquisite sight before me. It looked like
something taken right out of a caterer's advertisement.

dialogues.jp:
紅葉のかたちに型抜きされた御飯に飛龍頭の煮
物。
dialogues.en:
The colours of autumn was examplified in that box full of
boiled ganmodoki.
dialogues.text:
The colours of autumn was examplified in that box full of
boiled ganmodoki.

dialogues.jp:
現実に、こんなものに御目文字できるとは思っ
てもみなかった。
dialogues.en: I never thought I'd see such a beautiful sight.
dialogues.text: I never thought I'd see such a beautiful sight.

dialogues.jp: （ああ、生きてて良かった…………）
dialogues.en: "(Ahh, it's good to be alive...)"
dialogues.text: "(Ahh, it's good to be alive...)"

dialogues.jp:
味付けも全体的に気持ち薄めだが上品な感じで
大変に美味い。ていうか、この位のほうが毎日
食べるには飽きがこなくていいんだろうな。
dialogues.en:
I took a taste, and it was as good as it looked. I could eat
something like this every day and not get sick of it.
dialogues.text:
I took a taste, and it was as good as it looked. I could eat
something like this every day and not get sick of it.

dialogues.jp: 「んまああぁぁぁぁいいぃぃ」
dialogues.en: "Deeeeeeeeeelicious!"
dialogues.text: "Deeeeeeeeeelicious!"

dialogues.jp:
感涙にむせぶ俺を、困ったような微笑で見守る
工藤。
dialogues.en: I showed Kudou my manly tears of joy.
dialogues.text: I showed Kudou my manly tears of joy.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「や、やだな、大袈裟だよ朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "D, don't exaggerate it so much..."
dialogues.text: "D, don't exaggerate it so much..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「たしなみのひとつとして、小さい頃からお祖
　母さまが教えて下さったんです。私なんかま
　だまだ足元にも及びませんよ」
dialogues.en:
"Everything I know was taught to me by grandmother. I've
still got a long way to go to match her."
dialogues.text:
"Everything I know was taught to me by grandmother. I've
still got a long way to go to match her."

dialogues.jp:
祖母ちゃんのことを話す工藤は、どこかとても
誇らしげだった。
dialogues.en: She talked about her grandmother with pride.
dialogues.text: She talked about her grandmother with pride.

dialogues.jp: 「お祖母さんのこと、敬愛してるんだな」
dialogues.en: "You really like your grandmother, huh?"
dialogues.text: "You really like your grandmother, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。厳しい方ではありますが、それもすべ
　て私を立派に育てようとして下さっている為
　ですから……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. She may have been strict, but I understand it was all
to make sure that I grew up into a good person..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. She may have been strict, but I understand it was all
to make sure that I grew up into a good person..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「私も、それに応えなくちゃいけないんです」
dialogues.en: "I can't really argue against something like that."
dialogues.text: "I can't really argue against something like that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "...Kudou."
dialogues.text: "...Kudou."

dialogues.jp:
名家に恥じぬよう、工藤はどれだけ気を張って
生きてきたのか――。
dialogues.en: Maybe it was just my imagination...
dialogues.text: Maybe it was just my imagination...

dialogues.jp:
それは多分、俺なんかの想像の及ぶところでは
ないのだろう……。
dialogues.en:
But I seemed to get a feeling of shyness about her
distinguished family.
dialogues.text:
But I seemed to get a feeling of shyness about her
distinguished family.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、あんま無理はすんなよ。抜くとこは抜
　いていこうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"But don't keep everything to yourself. If you need to let
things out, I'd listen."
dialogues.text:
"But don't keep everything to yourself. If you need to let
things out, I'd listen."

dialogues.jp:
俺にはそれくらいしか言ってやることができな
い。
dialogues.en: That was all I could think of saying to cheer her up.
dialogues.text: That was all I could think of saying to cheer her up.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ふふ、ありがとう。最近は私も朝倉君のグー
　タラを見習うことにしてますから、大丈夫で
　すよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hehe, thank you. I should just learn from your
couldn't-care-less atttude and I'd be alright."
dialogues.text:
"Hehe, thank you. I should just learn from your
couldn't-care-less atttude and I'd be alright."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「って、お前なぁ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, that's...!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, that's...!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あはははははっ」
dialogues.en: "Ahahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Ahahahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
その時、一陣の風が桜の枝を揺らした。あおら
れた枝からぱらぱらと葉がちぎれて落ちてくる。
dialogues.en:
At the same time, a gust of wind caused the sakura tree
branches to sway. Leaves fell from the constant motion of
the branches.
dialogues.text:
At the same time, a gust of wind caused the sakura tree
branches to sway. Leaves fell from the constant motion of
the branches.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「きゃああぁぁぁぁあ！！？？」
dialogues.en: "Kyaaaahhhh!?!"
dialogues.text: "Kyaaaahhhh!?!"

dialogues.jp:
突如、工藤は高い悲鳴をあげて俺にすがりつい
て来た。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Kudou clinged onto my shoulder with a loud shriek.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Kudou clinged onto my shoulder with a loud shriek.

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんだ！？　どうかしたのか」
dialogues.en: "H, huh!? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "H, huh!? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「やあぁぁあっ……わ、私の肩に……っっ」
dialogues.en: "Yaaaah.... there's something on m, my shoulder...!"
dialogues.text: "Yaaaah.... there's something on m, my shoulder...!"

dialogues.jp:
その言葉に目をうつすと、着物の肩にぽっちり
と黒い点が落ちてもそもそと蠢いている。
dialogues.en:
Shifting my gaze to her shoulder, there was a black spot on
the shoulder of her kimono, wriggling.
dialogues.text:
Shifting my gaze to her shoulder, there was a black spot on
the shoulder of her kimono, wriggling.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、毛虫だろ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's just a caterpillar."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's just a caterpillar."

dialogues.jp:
俺は毛虫をつまみ、少し離れた枝の上に乗せて
やった。
dialogues.en:
I took the caterpillar away from her, and placed it on a
nearby tree branch.
dialogues.text:
I took the caterpillar away from her, and placed it on a
nearby tree branch.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「工藤、毛虫恐いんだ。可愛いな」
dialogues.en: "Heh, you're afraid of caterpillars... how cuuuute."
dialogues.text: "Heh, you're afraid of caterpillars... how cuuuute."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Muuu...."
dialogues.text: "Muuu...."

dialogues.jp:
俺にしっかり抱きついたまま、｛とが／咎｝めるように
見上げてくる。……かすかに涙を浮かべた瞳
がすぐ側にあった。
dialogues.en:
Even as she raised her gaze trying to blame me, she still
held my chest tightly. ...The side of her eyes were
glistening with tears.
dialogues.text:
Even as she raised her gaze trying to blame me, she still
held my chest tightly. ...The side of her eyes were
glistening with tears.

dialogues.jp: 胸の鼓動が｛にわ／俄｝かに高鳴り出す。
dialogues.en: The pounding in my chest started to throb violently.
dialogues.text: The pounding in my chest started to throb violently.

dialogues.jp: 工藤の身体は細くて温かくて、
dialogues.en: Kudou's figure was so slender and warm.
dialogues.text: Kudou's figure was so slender and warm.

dialogues.jp: 俺とは全然違う……女の子、だった。
dialogues.en: Completely unlike mine... a girl, indeed.
dialogues.text: Completely unlike mine... a girl, indeed.

dialogues.jp:
工藤の抑えた吐息が頬にかかる。軽やかな鼓動
が、俺のものと混じり合って……。
dialogues.en:
With a sigh, Kudou's breaths became regular again. Her calm
heartbeat was in stark contrast to mine.
dialogues.text:
With a sigh, Kudou's breaths became regular again. Her calm
heartbeat was in stark contrast to mine.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: 工藤の｛まぶた／瞼｝がゆっくりと伏せられる。
dialogues.en: Kudou's eyelids slowly closed over her eyes.
dialogues.text: Kudou's eyelids slowly closed over her eyes.

dialogues.en: "Kanae..."
dialogues.text: "Kanae..."

dialogues.jp: はじめて俺は彼女を名前で呼んだ。
dialogues.en: I said her name for the first time.
dialogues.text: I said her name for the first time.

dialogues.jp: そっと、唇が重なり合う。
dialogues.en: Our lips softly met.
dialogues.text: Our lips softly met.

dialogues.jp:
やわらかでいい香りがして、それはあの時と変
わらない。
dialogues.en:
The softness, tenderness, and smell, all was no different
from that time.
dialogues.text:
The softness, tenderness, and smell, all was no different
from that time.

dialogues.jp:
でも、「女の子」としての工藤の、いや、叶の
唇を知ったのは――今日がはじめてで……。
dialogues.en:
But this is the first time I know them as Kudou, no, Kanae,
the girl's, lips.
dialogues.text:
But this is the first time I know them as Kudou, no, Kanae,
the girl's, lips.

dialogues.jp:
そう、それは俺にとって「二度目のファースト
キス」だった。
dialogues.en: Indeed, that was the second coming of my first kiss.
dialogues.text: Indeed, that was the second coming of my first kiss.

dialogues.jp: ◆二度目のファーストキス◆
dialogues.en: ◆Second Coming of the First Kiss◆
dialogues.text: ◆Second Coming of the First Kiss◆

dialogues.jp:
俺のことが好きだと告げる工藤に、俺も自分の
気持ち、工藤を好きなことを告白した。
dialogues.en:
When Kudou informed me that she was in love with me, I was
finally able to let my feelings be known to her as well.
dialogues.text:
When Kudou informed me that she was in love with me, I was
finally able to let my feelings be known to her as well.

dialogues.jp: 俺と叶はそっとキスを交わした。
dialogues.en: Kudou and I then exchanged kisses.
dialogues.text: Kudou and I then exchanged kisses.
